memory: I have verified: 0.2 μL 0.05% acetic swab, 12 s dwell, lifts surface thermal/transfer coating and removes blue residue without observable ink migration at 15×; compression ridges intact. micro‑XRF spot (≈20 μm) repeatedly shows a low‑intensity Fe Kα ~6.40 keV after 30 min warm‑up and Fe‑foil calibration, but signal is marginal and detector gain drift increases noise. Standing plan: perform calibrated fixed‑stage 20 μm line‑scan with adjacent blanks, longer‑dwell sacrificial checks, thorough image documentation, and archive swab residues.
